issue.title: Snippet CLI (and restart CLI) tests assert a full tmp path that Rich truncates or wraps under the long agent-workspace basetemp
issue.description: Path-length-dependent CLI output assertions; see the CI failure body.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic in any agent workspace whose pytest basetemp is long (for example `~/.cache/sase/tmp/agent-tmp/gh_sase-org__sase-ws0-<stamp>/pytest-of-bryan/pytest-N/...`, about 150 characters to the file). Reproduced by the sase-18f land agent at master ae34dba20 with raw `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` (not a rerun-passes flake).

Root cause: the tests render through a Rich `Console(width=160)` and then assert the full `tmp_path`-derived path is a contiguous substring of the output. Under a long basetemp the table cell truncates the path with an ellipsis, e.g. `...t-tmp/gh_sase-org__sase-ws0-260924_183207/pytest-of-bryan/pytest-5/test_add_rich_format_states_cr0/workspace/sase/s…`, so the substring assertion fails. The governed `just check` full lane passes these nodes, which is why check stays green.

Nodes:
- `tests/main/test_snippet_cli_add.py::test_add_rich_format_states_created_action`
- `tests/main/test_snippet_cli_delete.py::test_delete_rich_format_prints_restore_and_removed_path`
- Same class, reported by sase-17m.4.1.land on sase-18f note #5 (passed for the sase-18f land agent, so path-length dependent): `tests/test_agent_restart_cli.py::test_wipe_failed_exits_1_and_prints_recovery_dir`, where the recovery-dir basename is line-wrapped in stderr.

Fix: make the assertions independent of basetemp length. Either render with a width that cannot truncate (or `overflow="fold"`/no-wrap for the path cell and normalize whitespace before asserting), or assert on a short stable suffix of the path. Do not shorten the product's rendering for real users. Proposed by sase-18f.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3).
